description: Asks what DateDiff returns at calendar boundaries for each interval (quarter and month across year end, leap day, weekday-based w, week-based ww under every first-day-of-week value 0 to 8, day/hour/minute/second across midnight by one second), for fractional day operands including pre-1899 negatives, for the widest ranges in seconds and days, text operands, and the first-week-of-year argument at its valid and invalid values. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
